sbar.situation: Payments is recovered after the incident commander rolled it back from release 1.5 to 1.3. The recovery check ran three looks, and the last two were clean in a row at 28 s.
sbar.background: ops-maintenance deployed payments 1.5, replacing 1.3. One second later payments began returning 503 'response_unavailable' errors on 43% of requests, and the ledger check found duplicate payments.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is the bad payments 1.5 release (confidence 0.85), which failed the probe at the payments step and wrote 99 duplicate payments to the ledger. The incident commander rolled payments back to 1.3 itself, and the main journey now runs clean. The screening-standby restarts are not part of this incident because the standby carries no traffic.
sbar.recommendation: This has been escalated as 'soon' to you and to the operations team for ledger and payments. A person must review the duplicate payments through normal reconciliation and correct the records; the escalation cites 170 duplicates against 99 at detection, so confirm the true count. The incident commander changed no money, balances or postings, so keep payments 1.5 off until its fault is found.
